lines.say: Your bank just sold your debt. To them.
It was only three hundred dollars.
This morning, the name on the letter changed. Lot Nine Recovery.
Tonight, three of them walk down your hallway. They don't knock twice.
They hold up a phone. It's your new monthly plan.
Follow the payment. It lands in the same tower as your bank.
Would you open the door? Write it in the comments.
